sources.title: Heart Failure: Diagnosis, Severity Estimation and Prediction of Adverse Events Through Machine Learning Techniques
sources.locator: The actual review separates detection, subtypes, severity, adverse events, rehospitalisation and mortality. Its summary discusses differing data sources and comparison of methods.

sources.title: TRIPOD+AI statement: updated guidance for reporting clinical prediction models that use regression or machine learning methods
sources.locator: The checklist covers development/evaluation context and transparent reporting; model evaluation, discrimination, calibration and clinical role are distinct information needs.

sources.title: Systems biology in cardiovascular disease: a multiomics approach
sources.locator: The review combines network theory with gene regulation, proteomics, metabolomics, lipidomics and phenomics; independent biological validation accompanies integration.

sources.title: Multi-omics approaches to disease
sources.locator: The review organises integrative analyses as genome-first, phenotype-first and environment-first, with study design, phenotyping, analytical integration and resolution as recurring needs.

sources.title: Proteomics in cardiology: research and practice
sources.locator: Recent review structures applications around disease mechanisms, prediction/detection, patient stratification and therapeutic-target prioritisation. It highlights reliable measurement, multiple platforms, longitudinal sampling and ancestry diversity.
